scope_decisions.rationale: FrozenWHO2026-01 parent groups detachments and breaks.9B73.4 is explicitly a break without detachment, so an added branch distinguishes traction tears/atrophic holes, low-risk observation, focal treatment and follow-up.9B73.Y/.Z retain the same condition family with mechanism assessment rather than inventing a specific cause. Existing general source-verified sections remain relevant; surgery/anaesthesia/gas instructions stay conditional on receiving that procedure. No mapping to macular hole, central serous chorioretinopathy, postoperative scar or peripheral degeneration without a break.

independence: ASRS and AAO EyeWiki are distinct editorial products but share some authors and AAO upstream practice evidence; not fully independent research. Moorfields UK and NEI US separately authored patient education support procedural action safeguards.
resolution: Accepted as source-bound independent editorial review after bilingual conditions/actions and14-dimensional content assessment; not clinical review or physician sign-off. Source access and shared-evidence limitations above remain disclosed.
